rive.cmd.decodeFont.brief: Decodes font bytes and returns a font handle.

rive.cmd.removeGlobalImageAsset.brief: Unregisters the named global image asset.

rive.cmd.removeGlobalAudioAsset.brief: Unregisters the named global audio asset.

rive.cmd.removeGlobalFontAsset.brief: Unregisters the named global font asset.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelNames.brief: Requests view model names for the file.

rive.cmd.requestArtboardNames.brief: Requests artboard names for the file.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceViewMod.brief: Requests the view model name used by the view model instance.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelEnums.brief: Requests enum definitions for the file.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelPropertyDefinit.brief: Requests property definitions for the view model.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceNames.brief: Requests instance names for the view model.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceBool.brief: Requests the boolean value for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceNumber.brief: Requests the numeric value for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceColor.brief: Requests the color value for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceEnum.brief: Requests the enum value for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceString.brief: Requests the string value for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceListSiz.brief: Requests the list size for the property.

rive.cmd.requestViewModelInstanceListCle.brief: Clears all entries from the nested list at the path.

rive.cmd.requestStateMachineNames.brief: Requests state machine names for the artboard.

rive.cmd.requestDefaultViewModelInfo.brief: Requests metadata about the default view model or artboard.

safearea.brief: Defold native extension that will change the view/render of a game to fit into the safe area on iPhones and Android(API 28+) with notch.

safearea.get_insets.brief: returns table with top, left, right, bottom values of insets and status

safearea.get_corners_radius.brief: returns a table with `top_left`, `top_right`, `bottom_left`, and `bottom_right` values of rounded corners and status.

siwa.brief: Functions and constants for interacting Sign in with Apple.

siwa.is_supported.brief: Check if Sign in with Apple is available (iOS 13+).

siwa.get_credential_state.brief: Get the credential state of a user.

siwa.authenticate.brief: Show the Sign in with Apple UI

siwa.STATE_REVOKED.brief: Authorization for the given user has been revoked.

siwa.STATUS_UNKNOWN.brief: The system hasn’t determined whether the user might be a real person.

siwa.STATUS_UNSUPPORTED.brief: The system can’t determine this user’s status as a real person.

siwa.STATUS_LIKELY_REAL.brief: The user appears to be a real person.

spine.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Spine models

spine.play_anim.brief: Plays the specified animation on a Spine model. A [ref:spine_animation_done] message is sent to the callback (or message handler). Any spine events will also be handled in the same way. The callback is not called (or message sent) if the animation is cancelled with [ref:spine.cancel]. The callback is called (or message sent) only for animations that play with the following playback modes * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_FORWARD` * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_BACKWARD` * `go.PLAYBACK_ONCE_PINGPONG`

spine.cancel.brief: Cancels all running animations on a specified spine model component

spine.get_go.brief: Returns the id of the game object that corresponds to a specified skeleton bone. Before using this function, make sure the "Create Go Bones" option is enabled in your Spine model.

spine.set_skin.brief: Sets the spine skin on a spine model.

spine.add_skin.brief: Adds one spine skin on a spine model to another on the same model.

spine.copy_skin.brief: Copies one spine skin on a spine model to another on the same model.

spine.clear_skin.brief: Clear all attachments and constraints from a skin on a spine model

spine.set_attachment.brief: Set the attachment of a slot on a spine model.

spine.set_slot_color.brief: Set the color a slot will tint its attachments on a spine model.

spine.reset_constant.brief: Resets a shader constant for a spine model component. (Previously set with `go.set()`)

spine.reset_ik_target.brief: reset the IK constraint target position to default of a spinemodel.

spine.set_ik_target_position.brief: set the target position of an IK constraint object.

spine.set_ik_target.brief: set the IK constraint object target position to follow position.

spine.physics_translate.brief: Apply a physics-based translation to the Spine model.

spine.physics_rotate.brief: Apply a physics-based rotation to the Spine model.

spine.gui.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Spine models in GUI

spine.gui.gui.new_spine_node.brief: Dynamically create a new spine node.

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_bone.brief: The returned node can be used for parenting and transform queries. This function has complexity O(n), where n is the number of bones in the spine model skeleton.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_scene.brief: Set the spine scene on a spine node. The spine scene must be mapped to the gui scene in the gui editor.

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_scene.brief: Returns the spine scene id of the supplied node. This is currently only useful for spine nodes. The returned spine scene must be mapped to the gui scene in the gui editor.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_skin.brief: Sets the spine skin on a spine node.

spine.gui.gui.add_spine_skin.brief: Add a spine skin on a spine node to another skin on the same node.

spine.gui.gui.copy_spine_skin.brief: Copy a spine skin on a spine node to another skin on the same node.

spine.gui.gui.clear_spine_skin.brief: Clear a spine skin on a spine node of all attachments and constraints

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_skin.brief: Gets the spine skin of a spine node

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_animation.brief: Gets the playing animation on a spine node

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_cursor.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. The cursor is normalized.

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_cursor.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. Gets the normalized cursor of the animation on a spine node.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_playback_rate.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. Sets the playback rate of the animation on a spine node. Must be positive.

spine.gui.gui.get_spine_playback_rate.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. Gets the playback rate of the animation on a spine node.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_attachment.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. Sets an attachment to a slot on a spine node.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_slot_color.brief: This is only useful for spine nodes. Sets a tint for all attachments on a slot

spine.gui.gui.spine_physics_translate.brief: Apply a physics-based translation to the Spine GUI node.

spine.gui.gui.spine_physics_rotate.brief: Apply a physics-based rotation to the Spine GUI node.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_ik_target_positi.brief: Sets a static (vector3) target position of an inverse kinematic (IK) object.

spine.gui.gui.set_spine_ik_target.brief: Sets a GUI node as target position of an inverse kinematic (IK) object. As the target GUI node's position is updated, the constraint object is updated with the new position.

spine.gui.gui.reset_spine_ik_target.brief: Resets any previously set IK target of a Spine GUI node, the position will be reset to the original position from the spine scene.

spine.resource.brief: Functions for creating Spine resources dynamically

spine.resource.resource.create_spinescen.brief: Creates a spinescene resource (.spinescenec) from runtime data. Creates a Spine scene resource dynamically at runtime. This allows loading Spine animations from data rather than pre-built assets. The atlas path must reference a compiled `.texturesetc` resource. The created spinescene is tracked for cleanup when the collection unloads; internal intermediate JSON is removed automatically.

steam.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Steamworks.

steam.update.brief: Update Steamworks. Call this from a script component.

steam.apps_is_dlc_installed.brief: Takes AppID of DLC and checks if the user owns the DLC & if the DLC is installed.

steam.friends_get_friend_persona_name.brief: Returns the name of another user. Same rules as GetFriendPersonaState() apply as to whether or not the user knowns the name of the other user note that on first joining a lobby, chat room or game server the local user will not known the name of the other users automatically; that information will arrive asyncronously.

steam.friends_get_persona_name.brief: Returns the local players name - guaranteed to not be NULL. This is the same name as on the users community profile page. This is stored in UTF-8 format.

steam.friends_get_persona_state.brief: Gets the status of the current user. Returned as EPersonaState.

steam.friends_get_friend_count.brief: Friend iteration. Takes a set of EFriendFlags, and returns the number of users the client knows about who meet that criteria. Then GetFriendByIndex() can then be used to return the id's of each of those users.

steam.friends_get_friend_by_index.brief: Returns the steamID of a user. The returned CSteamID can then be used by all the functions below to access details about the user.

steam.friends_get_friend_persona_state.brief: Returns the current status of the specified user. This will only be known by the local user if steamIDFriend is in their friends list; on the same game server; in a chat room or lobby; or in a small group with the local user.

steam.friends_get_friend_relationship.brief: Returns a relationship to a user.

steam.friends_get_small_friend_avatar.brief: Gets a handle to the small (32*32px) avatar for the specified user. This is a handle to be used in IClientUtils::GetImageRGBA(), or 0 if none set

steam.friends_get_medium_friend_avatar.brief: Gets a handle to the medium (64*64px) avatar for the specified user. This is a handle to be used in IClientUtils::GetImageRGBA(), or 0 if none set

steam.friends_get_large_friend_avatar.brief: Gets a handle to the large (128*128px) avatar for the specified user. This is a handle to be used in IClientUtils::GetImageRGBA(), or 0 if none set

steam.friends_activate_game_overlay_to_s.brief: Activates game overlay to store page for app.

steam.friends_activate_game_overlay_to_w.brief: Activates game overlay web browser directly to the specified URL. Full address with protocol type is required, e.g. http://www.steamgames.com/

steam.friends_set_rich_presence.brief: Sets a Rich Presence key/value for the current user.

steam.friends_clear_rich_presence.brief: Clears all of the current user's Rich Presence key/values.

steam.friends_invite_user_to_game.brief: Invites a friend or clan member to the current game using a special invite string. If the target accepts the invite, a GameRichPresenceJoinRequested_t callback is posted containing the connect string.

steam.matchmaking_add_request_lobby_list.brief: Adds a string comparison filter to the next RequestLobbyList call.
Adds a numerical comparison filter to the next RequestLobbyList call.
Sorts the results closest to the specified value.
Filters to only return lobbies with the specified number of open slots. Available.
Sets the physical distance for which we should search for lobbies, this is. Based on the users IP address and a IP location map on the Steam backed.
Sets the maximum number of lobbies to return. The lower the count the faster. It is to download the lobby results & details to the client.
Unused - Checks the player compatibility based on the frenemy system.

steam.matchmaking_request_lobby_list.brief: Get a filtered list of relevant lobbies. Will return results as a LobbyMatchList_t event

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_by_index.brief: Gets the Steam ID of the lobby at the specified index. This should only be called after a LobbyMatchList_t call result is received

steam.matchmaking_create_lobby.brief: Create a new matchmaking lobby. Will generate a LobbyCreated_t, LobbyEnter_t and LobbyDataUpdate_t event

steam.matchmaking_join_lobby.brief: Joins an existing lobby. Will generate a LobbyEnter_t event

steam.matchmaking_leave_lobby.brief: Leave a lobby that the user is currently in. Leave a lobby that the user is currently in; this will take effect immediately on the client side, other users in the lobby will be notified by a LobbyChatUpdate_t callback.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_owner.brief: Returns the current lobby owner. There always one lobby owner - if the current owner leaves, another user in the lobby will become the owner automatically. It is possible (but rare) to join a lobby just as the owner is leaving, thus entering a lobby with self as the owner. You must be a member of the lobby to access this.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_owner.brief: Changes who the lobby owner is. This can only be set by the owner of the lobby. This will trigger a LobbyDataUpdate_t for all of the users in the lobby, each user should update their local state to reflect the new owner. This is typically accomplished by displaying a crown icon next to the owners name.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_type.brief: Updates what type of lobby this is. This is also set when you create the lobby with CreateLobby. This can only be set by the owner of the lobby.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_joinable.brief: Sets whether or not a lobby is joinable by other players. This always defaults to enabled for a new lobby. If joining is disabled, then no players can join, even if they are a friend or have been invited. Lobbies with joining disabled will not be returned from a lobby search.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_member_limit.brief: Set the maximum number of players that can join the lobby. This is also set when you create the lobby with CreateLobby. This can only be set by the owner of the lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_num_lobby_members.brief: Gets the number of users in a lobby. This is used for iteration, after calling this then GetLobbyMemberByIndex can be used to get the Steam ID of each person in the lobby. Persona information for other lobby members (name, avatar, etc.) is automatically received and accessible via the ISteamFriends interface. The current user must be in the lobby to retrieve the Steam IDs of other users in that lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_member_by_in.brief: Gets the Steam ID of the lobby member at the given index. You must call matchmaking_get_num_lobby_members before calling this. The current user must be in the lobby to retrieve the Steam IDs of other users in that lobby.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_data.brief: Sets a key/value pair in the lobby metadata.

steam.matchmaking_set_lobby_member_data.brief: Sets per-user metadata for the local user.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_data.brief: Get data associated with this lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_member_data.brief: Gets per-user metadata from another player in the specified lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_data_count.brief: Returns the number of metadata keys set on the specified lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_data_by_inde.brief: Returns a lobby metadata key/values pair by index.

steam.matchmaking_send_lobby_chat_messag.brief: Broadcasts a chat message to the all the users in the lobby.

steam.matchmaking_get_lobby_chat_entry.brief: Get a chat message as specified in a LobbyChatMsg_t callback.

steam.networking_accept_session_with_use.brief: Accept session. Call this in response to a SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t callback.

steam.networking_close_session_with_user.brief: Close sesssion. Call this when you're done talking to a user to immediately free up resources under-the-hood

steam.networking_close_channel_with_user.brief: Close channel. Call this when you're done talking to a user on a specific channel.

steam.networking_get_session_connection_.brief: Get connection info. Returns information about the latest state of a connection, if any, with the given peer.

steam.remote_storage_file_write.brief: Creates a new file, writes the bytes to the file, and then closes the file. If the target file already exists, it is overwritten.

steam.remote_storage_file_read.brief: Opens a binary file, reads the contents of the file into a byte array,. And then closes the file.

steam.user_get_steam_id.brief: Returns the CSteamID of the account currently logged into the Steam client. A CSteamID is a unique identifier for an account, and used to differentiate users in all parts of the Steamworks API.

steam.user_get_player_steam_level.brief: Gets the Steam Level of the user, as shown on their profile.

steam.user_get_game_badge_level.brief: Trading Card badges data access. If you only have one set of cards, the series will be 1. The user has can have two different badges for a series; the regular (max level 5) and the foil (max level 1).

steam.user_logged_on.brief: Returns true if the Steam client current has a live connection to the Steam. Servers.

steam.user_is_behind_nat.brief: Returns true if this users looks like they are behind a NAT device. Only valid once the user has connected to steam .

steam.user_is_phone_verified.brief: Gets whether the users phone number is verified.

steam.user_is_phone_identifying.brief: Gets whether the users phone number is identifying.

steam.user_is_phone_requiring_verificati.brief: Gets whether the users phone number is awaiting (re)verification.

steam.user_is_two_factor_enabled.brief: Gets whether the user has two factor enabled on their account.

steam.user_get_auth_session_ticket.brief: Get an authentication ticket. Retrieve an authentication ticket to be sent to the entity who wishes to authenticate you.

steam.user_begin_auth_session.brief: Validate an authentication ticket. Authenticate the ticket from the entity Steam ID to be sure it is valid and isn't reused. Note that identity is not confirmed until the callback ValidateAuthTicketResponse_t is received and the return value in that callback is checked for success.

steam.user_cancel_auth_ticket.brief: Cancels an auth ticket. Cancels an auth ticket received from GetAuthSessionTicket or GetAuthTicketForWebApi. This should be called when no longer playing with the specified entity.

steam.user_end_auth_session.brief: Ends an auth session. Ends an auth session that was started with BeginAuthSession. This should be called when no longer playing with the specified entity.

steam.user_get_auth_ticket_for_web_api.brief: Get an authentication ticket for web API. Request an authentication ticket suitable to authenticated in a web backend. Will trigger a GetTicketForWebApiResponse_t callback when the ticket is ready.

steam.user_stats_get_stat_int.brief: Get user stat as an integer. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetStat

steam.user_stats_get_stat_float.brief: Get user stat as a floating point number. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetStat

steam.user_stats_request_global_stats.brief: Requests global stats data, which is available for stats marked as "aggregated". This call is asynchronous, with the results returned in GlobalStatsReceived_t. nHistoryDays specifies how many days of day-by-day history to retrieve in addition to the overall totals. The limit is 60. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#RequestGlobalStats

steam.user_stats_store_stats.brief: Store the current data on the server. Will get a callback when set and one callback for every new achievement If the callback has a result of k_EResultInvalidParam, one or more stats uploaded has been rejected, either because they broke constraints or were out of date. In this case the server sends back updated values. The stats should be re-iterated to keep in sync. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#StoreStats

steam.user_stats_get_num_achievements.brief: Used for iterating achievements. In general games should not need these functions because they should have a list of existing achievements compiled into them. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetNumAchievements

steam.user_stats_get_achievement_display.brief: Get general attributes for an achievement. Accepts the following keys * "name" and "desc" for retrieving the localized achievement name and description (returned in UTF8) * "hidden" for retrieving if an achievement is hidden (returns "0" when not hidden, "1" when hidden) https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetAchievementDisplayAttribute

steam.user_stats_get_achievement_achieve.brief: Returns the percentage of users who have achieved the specified achievement. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetAchievementAchievedPercent

steam.user_stats_find_leaderboard.brief: Find a leaderboard. Will return leaderboard asynchronously. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#FindLeaderboard

steam.user_stats_find_or_create_leaderbo.brief: Gets a leaderboard by name, it will create it if it's not yet created. This call is asynchronous, with the result returned in a listener callback with event set to LeaderboardFindResult_t. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#FindOrCreateLeaderboard

steam.user_stats_get_leaderboard_name.brief: Get the name of a leaderboard. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetLeaderboardName

steam.user_stats_get_leaderboard_entry_c.brief: Get the total number of entries in a leaderboard, as of the last request. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetLeaderboardEntryCount

steam.user_stats_get_leaderboard_sort_me.brief: Returns the sort method of the leaderboard. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetLeaderboardSortMethod

steam.user_stats_get_leaderboard_display.brief: Returns the display type of a leaderboard handle. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetLeaderboardDisplayType

steam.user_stats_download_leaderboard_en.brief: Asks the Steam back-end for a set of rows in the leaderboard. This call is asynchronous, with the result returned in a listener callback with event set to LeaderboardScoresDownloaded_t. LeaderboardScoresDownloaded_t will contain a handle to pull the results from GetDownloadedLeaderboardEntries(). You can ask for more entries than exist, and it will return as many as do exist. * k_ELeaderboardDataRequestGlobal requests rows in the leaderboard from the full table, with nRangeStart & nRangeEnd in the range [1, TotalEntries] * k_ELeaderboardDataRequestGlobalAroundUser requests rows around the current user, nRangeStart being negate e.g. DownloadLeaderboardEntries( hLeaderboard, k_ELeaderboardDataRequestGlobalAroundUser, -3, 3 ) will return 7 rows, 3 before the user, 3 after * k_ELeaderboardDataRequestFriends requests all the rows for friends of the current user https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#DownloadLeaderboardEntries

steam.user_stats_get_downloaded_leaderbo.brief: Returns data about a single leaderboard entry. Https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#GetDownloadedLeaderboardEntry

steam.user_stats_upload_leaderboard_scor.brief: Uploads a user score to a specified leaderboard. This call is asynchronous, with the result returned in a listener callback with event set to LeaderboardScoreUploaded_t. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#UploadLeaderboardScore

steam.user_stats_attach_leadboard_ugc.brief: Attaches a piece of user generated content the current user's entry on a. Leaderboard. https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/api/ISteamUserStats#AttachLeaderboardUGC

steam.utils_get_app_id.brief: Returns the appID of the current process.

steam.utils_get_seconds_since_app_active.brief: Return the number of seconds since the user.

steam.utils_is_steam_running_on_steam_de.brief: Returns true if currently running on the Steam Deck device.

steam.utils_is_steam_overlay_available.brief: Returns true if the Steam Overlay is running and the user can access it.

steam.utils_get_server_real_time.brief: Returns the Steam server time in Unix epoch format. (Number of seconds since Jan 1, 1970 UTC).

steam.utils_show_floating_gamepad_text_i.brief: Opens a floating keyboard over the game content and sends OS keyboard keys directly to the game.

steam.utils_show_gamepad_text_input.brief: Activates the Big Picture text input dialog which only supports gamepad input.

steam.EFloatingGamepadTextInputModeModeM.brief: User needs to explicitly dismiss the keyboard

steam.EFloatingGamepadTextInputModeModeE.brief: Keyboard is displayed in a special mode that makes it easier to enter emails

steam.ELeaderboardDataRequestGlobal.brief: Requests rows in the leaderboard from the full table.

steam.ELeaderboardDataRequestGlobalAroun.brief: Requests rows in the leaderboard from rows around the user.

steam.ELeaderboardDataRequestFriends.brief: Requests all the rows for friends of the current user.

steam.ELeaderboardUploadScoreMethodKeepB.brief: Leaderboard will keep user's best score.

steam.ELeaderboardUploadScoreMethodForce.brief: Leaderboard will always replace score with specified.

steam.ELeaderboardDisplayTypeTimeSeconds.brief: The score represents a time, in seconds.

steam.ELeaderboardDisplayTypeTimeMilliSe.brief: The score represents a time, in milliseconds.

steam.EOverlayToStoreFlag_None.brief: Passed as parameter to the store.

steam.EOverlayToStoreFlag_AddToCart.brief: Passed as parameter to the store.

steam.EOverlayToStoreFlag_AddToCartAndSh.brief: Passed as parameter to the store.

steam.EPersonaStateOffline.brief: Friend is not currently logged on.

steam.EPersonaStateInvisible.brief: Online, but appears offline to friends. This status is never published to clients.

steam.ELobbyTypePrivate.brief: ELobbyTypePrivate only way to join the lobby is to invite to someone else

steam.ELobbyTypeFriendsOnly.brief: ELobbyTypeFriendsOnly shows for friends or invitees, but not in lobby list

steam.ELobbyTypePublic.brief: ELobbyTypePublic visible for friends and in lobby list

steam.ELobbyTypeInvisible.brief: ELobbyTypeInvisible returned by search, but not visible to other friends

steam.ELobbyTypePrivateUnique.brief: ELobbyTypePrivateUnique private, unique and does not delete when empty

steam.EAuthSessionResponseOK.brief: EAuthSessionResponseOK Steam has verified the user is online, the ticket is valid and ticket has not been reused.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseUserNotConnect.brief: EAuthSessionResponseUserNotConnectedToSteam The user in question is not connected to steam.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseNoLicenseOrExp.brief: EAuthSessionResponseNoLicenseOrExpired The user doesn't have a license for this App ID or the ticket has expired.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseVACBanned.brief: EAuthSessionResponseVACBanned The user is VAC banned for this game.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseLoggedInElseWh.brief: EAuthSessionResponseLoggedInElseWhere The user account has logged in elsewhere and the session containing the game instance has been disconnected.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseVACCheckTimedO.brief: EAuthSessionResponseVACCheckTimedOut VAC has been unable to perform anti-cheat checks on this user.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketCanc.brief: EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketCanceled The ticket has been canceled by the issuer.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketInva.brief: EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketInvalidAlreadyUsed This ticket has already been used, it is not valid.
EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketInvalid This ticket is not from a user instance currently connected to steam.

steam.EAuthSessionResponsePublisherIssue.brief: EAuthSessionResponsePublisherIssuedBan The user is banned for this game. The ban came via the web api and not VAC.

steam.EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketNetw.brief: EAuthSessionResponseAuthTicketNetworkIdentityFailure The network identity in the ticket does not match the server authenticating the ticket.

mpeg.close.brief: Close an opened video. This will release an memory allocated by the videoplayer.

mpeg.decode.brief: Advance the internal timer by seconds and decode video/audio up to this time.

mpeg.write.brief: Write data to the internal stream buffer of a video started with stream(). Use the `streaming_buffer_bytes_remaining` and `streaming_buffer_capacity` to determine how much data to write to the buffer.

mpeg.seek.brief: Seek to the specified time. Will seek to the last intra frame just before the desired time.

mpeg.get_frame.brief: Get the video frame buffer. The video frame buffer will be updated when decode() is called and enough data has been decoded to produce a frame.

mpeg.get_info.brief: Get information about an opened video.

videoplayer.brief: Fullscreen video playback using native/HTML5 backends.

videoplayer.create.brief: Create a video handle for a URI and register a callback.

videoplayer.destroy.brief: Destroy a video handle and remove the view.

videoplayer.stop.brief: Stop playback without removing the video view or emitting VIDEO_EVENT_FINISHED. Call destroy to skip and remove the video.

videoplayer.set_visible.brief: Show or hide the video view.

videoplayer.VIDEO_EVENT_READY.brief: Video is prepared; data contains width/height.

websocket.brief: Functions and constants for using websockets. Supported on all platforms.

webview.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with webview APIs

webview.create.brief:
Creates a webview instance. It can show HTML pages as well as evaluate Javascript. The view remains hidden until the first call. There can exist a maximum of 4 webviews at the same time.
On iOS, the callback will never get a `webview.CALLBACK_RESULT_EVAL_ERROR`, due to the iOS SDK implementation."

webview.destroy.brief: Destroys an instance of a webview.

webview.open.brief: Opens a web page in the webview, using an URL. Once the request is done, the callback (registered in `webview.create()`) is invoked.

webview.open_raw.brief: Opens a web page in the webview, using HTML data. Once the request is done, the callback (registered in `webview.create()`) is invoked.

webview.eval.brief: Evaluates JavaScript within the context of the currently loaded page (if any). Once the request is done, the callback (registered in `webview.create()`) is invoked. The callback will get the result in the `data["result"]` field.

webview.is_visible.brief: Returns the visibility state of the webview.

webview.set_position.brief: Sets the position and size of the webview

shop.brief: Functions to use the Xsolla Shop Builder API.

shop.set_username_password.brief: Set a username and password for basic authentication

shop.set_merchant_auth.brief: Set merchant id and api key for use with 'basicMerchantAuth' authentication

shop.get_bundle_list_in_group.brief: Get list of bundles by specified group

shop.cart_clear_by_id.brief: Delete all cart items by cart ID

shop.cart_clear.brief: Delete all cart items from current cart

shop.put_item_by_cart_id.brief: Update cart item by cart ID

shop.delete_item_by_cart_id.brief: Delete cart item by cart ID

shop.put_item.brief: Update cart item from current cart

shop.delete_item.brief: Delete cart item from current cart

shop.create_order_by_cart_id.brief: Create order with all items from particular cart

shop.create_order.brief: Create order with all items from current cart

shop.create_free_order_by_cart_id.brief: Create order with particular free cart

shop.create_free_order_with_item.brief: Create order with specified free item

shop.get_upsell_for_project_client.brief: Get list of upsell items in project

shop.get_games_group.brief: Get games list by specified group

shop.get_game_keys_group.brief: Get game keys list by specified group

shop.get_user_games.brief: Get list of games owned by user

shop.get_virtual_currency_package_sku.brief: Get virtual currency package by SKU

shop.get_virtual_items_group.brief: Get items list by specified group

shop.create_order_with_item_for_virtual_.brief: Create order with specified item purchased by virtual currency

shop.get_sellable_items_group.brief: Get sellable items list by specified group

shop.get_user_reward_chain_balance.brief: Get current user's value point balance

shop.get_user_clan_top_contributors.brief: Get top 10 contributors to reward chain under clan

zendesk.brief: Defold native extension to interact with the Zendesk SDK.

zendesk.set_callback.brief: Set a callback for events from the Zendesk SDK

zendesk.set_conversation_fields.brief: Set conversation fields in the SDK to add contextual data about the conversation.

zendesk.clear_conversation_fields.brief: Clear conversation fields from the SDK storage when the client side context changes.

zendesk.set_conversation_tags.brief: Set custom conversation tags in the SDK to add contextual data about the conversation.

zendesk.clear_conversation_tags.brief: Clear conversation tags from SDK storage when the client side context changes.

zendesk.MSG_INIT_ERROR.brief: An error was detected while initializing the Zendesk SDK

zendesk.MSG_INIT_SUCCESS.brief: The Zendesk SDK has been initialized successfully

zendesk.MSG_UNREAD_MESSAGE_COUNT_CHANGED.brief: The number of unread messages has changed

zendesk.MSG_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.brief: A REST call failed for authentication reasons

zendesk.MSG_FIELD_VALIDATION_FAILED.brief: Validation checks failed for conversation fields

directories.brief: Absolute paths inside the platform's standard directories: application support, caches, documents, resource and temporary.

directories.path_for_file.brief:
Resolves an absolute path for a file inside one of the system
directories.

directories.application_support.brief: The platform's application-support directory, for {@link directories.path_for_file}.

directories.caches.brief: The platform's directory for cached files, which the OS may clear to free space, for {@link directories.path_for_file}.

directories.documents.brief: The platform's directory for the app's private data files, persistent across restarts, for {@link directories.path_for_file}.

directories.resource.brief: The app's resource directory, the default base, for {@link directories.path_for_file}.

directories.temporary.brief: The platform's directory for temporary files, for {@link directories.path_for_file}.

box2d.brief: Box2D physics: worlds, bodies, fixtures, shapes and joints.

box2d.NewDebugDraw.brief:
Creates a debug draw to register with {@link World.SetDebugDraw}. Its
callbacks run in the script instance that created it; call
{@link DebugDraw.Destroy} when it is no longer needed.

box2d.NewPolygonShape.brief:
Creates an empty polygon shape. Give it vertices with
{@link PolygonShape.Set} or {@link PolygonShape.SetAsBox}.

box2d.NewCircleShape.brief: Creates a circle shape with a radius of 0.

box2d.NewChainShape.brief:
Creates an empty chain shape. Give it vertices with
{@link ChainShape.CreateLoop} or {@link ChainShape.CreateChain}.

box2d.NewEdgeShape.brief:
Creates an edge shape. Give it vertices with {@link EdgeShape.SetTwoSided}
or {@link EdgeShape.SetOneSided}.

box2d.b2LinearStiffness.brief: Computes linear stiffness and damping from a frequency and a damping ratio.

box2d.b2AngularStiffness.brief: Computes angular stiffness and damping from a frequency and a damping ratio.

box2d.InitializeRevoluteJointDef.brief:
Fills a revolute joint definition: the bodies, the local anchors and the
reference angle, from a world anchor.

box2d.InitializePrismaticJointDef.brief:
Fills a prismatic joint definition: the bodies, the local anchors, the
axis and the reference angle, from a world anchor and a unit world axis.

box2d.InitializeDistanceJointDef.brief:
Fills a distance joint definition: the bodies, the local anchors and the
rest length, from world anchors. The minimum and maximum lengths are set
to the rest length.

box2d.InitializePulleyJointDef.brief:
Fills a pulley joint definition: the bodies, the anchors, the lengths and
the ratio, from world anchors.

box2d.InitializeMouseJointDef.brief: Fills a mouse joint definition with the two bodies.

box2d.InitializeGearJointDef.brief:
Fills a gear joint definition with the two bodies and the two joints it
connects.

box2d.InitializeWheelJointDef.brief:
Fills a wheel joint definition: the bodies, the local anchors and the
axis, from a world anchor and a world axis.

box2d.InitializeWeldJointDef.brief:
Fills a weld joint definition: the bodies, the local anchors and the
reference angle, from a world anchor.

box2d.InitializeFrictionJointDef.brief:
Fills a friction joint definition: the bodies and the local anchors, from
a world anchor.

box2d.InitializeMotorJointDef.brief:
Fills a motor joint definition: the bodies and the offsets, from their
current transforms.

box2d.b2BodyType.b2_staticBody.brief: Zero mass, zero velocity; may be moved by hand.

box2d.b2BodyType.b2_kinematicBody.brief: Zero mass, velocity set by the user, moved by the solver.

box2d.b2BodyType.b2_dynamicBody.brief: Positive mass, velocity determined by forces, moved by the solver.

box2d.b2Draw.e_centerOfMassBit.brief: Draw the center of mass frame.

box2d.World.SetDestructionListener.brief: Registers a destruction listener, replacing any earlier one.

box2d.World.SetContactListener.brief:
Registers a contact listener, replacing any earlier one. Its callbacks
run in the script instance that registered it.

box2d.World.SetDebugDraw.brief:
Registers the debug draw that {@link World.DebugDraw} calls. The debug
draw stays owned by the caller.

box2d.World.CreateBody.brief: Creates a rigid body. Not allowed during callbacks.

box2d.World.DestroyBody.brief: Destroys a body, with its fixtures and joints. Not allowed during callbacks.

box2d.World.CreateJoint.brief:
Creates a joint whose kind is known only at run time. Not allowed
during callbacks.

box2d.World.DestroyJoint.brief:
Destroys a joint. The bodies it connected may begin to collide. Not
allowed during callbacks.

box2d.World.Step.brief:
Takes a time step: collision detection, integration and constraint
solution. Contact listener callbacks run inside it.

box2d.World.ClearForces.brief:
Clears the force buffer on all bodies. Forces clear after each step
unless {@link World.SetAutoClearForces} turned that off, for sub-stepping.

box2d.World.DebugDraw.brief: Calls the registered debug draw for the shapes and other debug data.

box2d.World.RayCast.brief:
Casts a ray against every fixture in its path. The ray ignores shapes
that contain its start.

box2d.World.QueryAABB.brief: Finds every fixture whose AABB overlaps a box.

box2d.World.GetBodyList.brief: Gets the first body in the world. Use {@link Body.GetNext} for the rest.

box2d.World.GetContactList.brief:
Gets the first contact in the world. Use {@link Contact.GetNext} for the
rest. Contacts come and go during a time step, so use a
{@link ContactListener} not to miss any.

box2d.World.GetJointList.brief: Gets the first joint in the world. Use {@link Joint.GetNext} for the rest.

box2d.World.SetWarmStarting.brief: Enables or disables warm starting. For testing.

box2d.World.SetContinuousPhysics.brief: Enables or disables continuous physics. For testing.

box2d.World.SetSubStepping.brief: Enables or disables single-stepped continuous physics. For testing.

box2d.World.GetSubStepping.brief: Whether single-stepped continuous physics is enabled.

box2d.World.GetProxyCount.brief: Gets the number of broad-phase proxies.

box2d.World.GetContactCount.brief: Gets the number of contacts, each with zero or more contact points.

box2d.World.GetTreeHeight.brief: Gets the height of the dynamic tree.

box2d.World.GetTreeBalance.brief: Gets the balance of the dynamic tree.

box2d.World.GetTreeQuality.brief: Gets the quality metric of the dynamic tree. Smaller is better; the minimum is 1.

box2d.World.IsLocked.brief: Whether the world is in the middle of a time step.

box2d.World.SetAutoClearForces.brief: Sets whether forces clear automatically after each time step.

box2d.World.GetAutoClearForces.brief: Whether forces clear automatically after each time step.

box2d.World.ShiftOrigin.brief:
Shifts the world origin, for large worlds. Each body's position becomes
`position - newOrigin`.

box2d.World.GetProfile.brief: Gets the profile of the last step.

box2d.World.Dump.brief: Dumps the world to the log. Call it outside a time step. Not supported on Android or iOS.

box2d.World.Destroy.brief: Destroys the world with its bodies, fixtures, joints, contacts and listeners.

box2d.DestructionListener.SayGoodbyeFixt.brief: Called before the fixture is destroyed.

box2d.DestructionListener.SayGoodbyeJoin.brief: Called before the joint is destroyed.

box2d.Fixture.GetType.brief: Gets the type of the fixture's shape.

box2d.Fixture.GetShape.brief: Gets a copy of the shape. Changing the copy does not change the fixture.

box2d.Fixture.SetSensor.brief: Sets whether this fixture is a sensor.

box2d.Fixture.IsSensor.brief: Whether this fixture is a sensor (non-solid).

box2d.Fixture.SetFilterData.brief:
Sets the contact filtering data. Contacts update at the next step when
either body is active and awake. This calls {@link Fixture.Refilter}.

box2d.Fixture.Refilter.brief: Re-establishes collision that a contact filter previously disabled.

box2d.Fixture.GetBody.brief: Gets the body this fixture is attached to.

box2d.Fixture.GetNext.brief: Gets the next fixture in the body's fixture list.

box2d.Fixture.TestPoint.brief: Tests a point for containment in this fixture.

box2d.Fixture.RayCast.brief: Casts a ray against this fixture's shape.

box2d.Fixture.GetMassData.brief:
Gets the mass data, from the density and the shape. The inertia is about
the shape's origin. This may be expensive.

box2d.Fixture.SetDensity.brief:
Sets the density. This does not update the body's mass; call
{@link Body.ResetMassData} for that.

box2d.Fixture.SetFriction.brief: Sets the friction coefficient. Existing contacts keep their friction.

box2d.Fixture.SetRestitution.brief: Sets the restitution coefficient. Existing contacts keep their restitution.

box2d.Fixture.SetRestitutionThreshold.brief: Sets the restitution velocity threshold. Existing contacts keep theirs.

box2d.Fixture.GetAABB.brief:
Gets the fixture's AABB, which may be enlarged or stale. For an exact
box, compute it from the shape and the body transform.

box2d.Fixture.Dump.brief: Dumps this fixture to the log.

box2d.Shape.GetType.brief: Gets the type of this shape. Use it to tell which shape type the object is.

box2d.Shape.GetChildCount.brief: Gets the number of child primitives.

box2d.Shape.TestPoint.brief: Tests a point for containment in this shape. This only works for convex shapes.

box2d.Shape.RayCast.brief: Casts a ray against a child shape.

box2d.Shape.ComputeAABB.brief: Computes the axis-aligned bounding box of a child shape.

box2d.Shape.ComputeMass.brief:
Computes the mass properties of this shape from its dimensions and
density. The inertia is computed about the local origin.

box2d.Shape.GetRadius.brief: Gets the radius. For a polygon it is the polygon skin radius.

box2d.MassData.center.brief: The position of the center of mass relative to the shape origin. A plain `{x, y}` table.

box2d.MassData.I.brief: The rotational inertia about the local origin.

box2d.Filter.categoryBits.brief: The collision category bits. Normally one bit is set.

box2d.Filter.maskBits.brief: The categories this shape accepts for collision.

box2d.Filter.groupIndex.brief:
Objects in the same negative group never collide; in the same positive
group they always collide. Zero means no group. A non-zero group wins
over the mask bits.

box2d.Body.CreateFixture.brief:
Creates a fixture from a shape and attaches it to this body. Use a
{@link FixtureDef} to set friction, restitution, user data or
filtering. Not allowed during callbacks.

box2d.Body.DestroyFixture.brief:
Destroys a fixture, removing it from the broad-phase and destroying its
contacts. A dynamic body's mass is adjusted if the fixture had positive
density. Not allowed during callbacks.

box2d.Body.SetTransform.brief:
Sets the position of the body's origin and its rotation. This may cause
non-physical behavior; contacts update at the next step.

box2d.Body.GetTransform.brief: Gets the transform of the body's origin.

box2d.Body.GetPosition.brief: Gets the world position of the body's origin.

box2d.Body.GetPositionRaw.brief:
Gets the world position of the body's origin as two numbers, with no
`vector3` allocated.

box2d.Body.GetWorldCenter.brief: Gets the world position of the center of mass.

box2d.Body.GetLocalCenter.brief: Gets the local position of the center of mass.

box2d.Body.SetLinearVelocity.brief: Sets the linear velocity of the center of mass.

box2d.Body.GetLinearVelocity.brief: Gets the linear velocity of the center of mass.

box2d.Body.ApplyForce.brief:
Applies a force at a world point. Off the center of mass it also
produces a torque.

box2d.Body.ApplyForceToCenter.brief: Applies a force to the center of mass.

box2d.Body.ApplyTorque.brief:
Applies a torque. This changes the angular velocity but not the linear
velocity of the center of mass.

box2d.Body.ApplyLinearImpulse.brief:
Applies an impulse at a world point. This changes the velocity at once,
and the angular velocity if the point is off the center of mass.

box2d.Body.ApplyLinearImpulseToCenter.brief: Applies an impulse to the center of mass. This changes the velocity at once.

box2d.Body.GetInertia.brief: Gets the rotational inertia about the local origin.

box2d.Body.ResetMassData.brief:
Resets the mass properties to the sum of the fixtures' mass properties.
Needed only after {@link Body.SetMassData} overrode them.

box2d.Body.SetMassData.brief:
Overrides the mass properties of the fixtures. This moves the center of
mass, and has no effect on a body that is not dynamic.

box2d.Body.GetWorldPoint.brief: Converts a local point to world coordinates.

box2d.Body.GetWorldVector.brief: Converts a local vector to world coordinates.

box2d.Body.GetLocalPoint.brief: Converts a world point to a point relative to the body's origin.

box2d.Body.GetLocalVector.brief: Converts a world vector to a local vector.

box2d.Body.GetLinearVelocityFromLocalPoi.brief: Gets the world velocity of a local point.

box2d.Body.GetLinearVelocityFromWorldPoi.brief: Gets the world velocity of a world point attached to this body.

box2d.Body.SetType.brief: Sets the body type. This may change the mass and velocity.

box2d.Body.SetBullet.brief: Sets whether the body is treated like a bullet for continuous collision detection.

box2d.Body.IsBullet.brief: Whether the body is treated like a bullet for continuous collision detection.

box2d.Body.SetSleepingAllowed.brief: Sets whether the body may sleep. Disallowing sleep wakes the body.

box2d.Body.SetAwake.brief: Wakes the body or puts it to sleep. A sleeping body costs very little CPU.

box2d.Body.SetEnabled.brief:
Enables or disables the body. A disabled body is not simulated, cannot
be collided with or woken, and stays in the world. Its fixtures leave
the broad-phase and its contacts are destroyed; its joints are
implicitly disabled.

box2d.Body.SetFixedRotation.brief: Sets whether the body has fixed rotation. This resets the mass.

box2d.Body.IsFixedRotation.brief: Whether the body has fixed rotation.

box2d.Body.GetNext.brief: Gets the next body in the world's body list.

box2d.Body.GetFixtureList.brief:
Gets the first fixture attached to this body. Use {@link Fixture.GetNext}
for the rest.

box2d.Body.GetContactList.brief:
Gets the contacts attached to this body. The list changes during the
time step, so use a {@link ContactListener} not to miss collisions.

**⚠️ The list is the body's own table, filled from index 1; a contact
from an earlier, longer call stays past the end of the current list.**

box2d.Body.GetJointList.brief:
Gets the joints attached to this body.

**⚠️ The list is the body's own table, filled from index 1; a joint from
an earlier, longer call stays past the end of the current list.**

box2d.Body.GetWorld.brief: Gets the world this body belongs to.

box2d.Body.Dump.brief: Dumps this body to the log.

box2d.FixtureDef.shape.brief: The shape. The fixture gets a copy.

box2d.FixtureDef.userData.brief: Application data. Must be a table.

box2d.FixtureDef.friction.brief: The friction coefficient, usually from 0 to 1. Default is 0.2.

box2d.FixtureDef.restitution.brief: The restitution (elasticity), usually from 0 to 1. Default is 0.

box2d.FixtureDef.restitutionThreshold.brief: Collisions above this speed, in meters per second, bounce. Default is 1.

box2d.FixtureDef.density.brief: The density, usually in kilograms per square meter. Default is 0.

box2d.FixtureDef.isSensor.brief: A sensor collects contact information but never generates a collision response.

box2d.CircleShapeTable.circle_position.brief: The center relative to the body origin. Default is the origin.

box2d.OneSidedEdgeShapeTable.edge_v0.brief: The vertex that precedes the edge.

box2d.OneSidedEdgeShapeTable.edge_v3.brief: The vertex that follows the edge.

box2d.PolygonShapeTable.polygon_vertices.brief: From 3 to 8 points; their convex hull is used.

box2d.LoopChainShapeTable.chain_loop.brief: Closes the chain into a loop.

box2d.OpenChainShapeTable.chain_prev_ver.brief: The vertex that connects to the start.

box2d.OpenChainShapeTable.chain_next_ver.brief: The vertex that connects to the end.

box2d.Contact.GetNext.brief: Gets the next contact in the world's contact list.

box2d.Contact.SetEnabled.brief:
Enables or disables this contact for the current time step (or
sub-step in continuous collisions). Use it inside `PreSolve`.

box2d.Contact.GetChildIndexA.brief: Gets the child primitive index for fixture A.

box2d.Contact.GetChildIndexB.brief: Gets the child primitive index for fixture B.

box2d.Contact.SetFriction.brief:
Overrides the default friction mixture. Call it in `PreSolve`; the value
persists until it is set or reset.

box2d.Contact.ResetFriction.brief: Resets the friction mixture to the default value.

box2d.Contact.SetRestitution.brief:
Overrides the default restitution mixture. Call it in `PreSolve`; the
value persists until it is set or reset.

box2d.Contact.ResetRestitution.brief: Resets the restitution to the default value.

box2d.Contact.SetRestitutionThreshold.brief:
Overrides the default restitution velocity threshold mixture. Call it in
`PreSolve`; the value persists until it is set or reset.

box2d.Contact.ResetRestitutionThreshold.brief: Resets the restitution threshold to the default value.

box2d.Contact.SetTangentSpeed.brief: Sets the desired tangent speed for a conveyor belt, in meters per second.

box2d.Contact.GetTangentSpeed.brief: Gets the desired tangent speed, in meters per second.

box2d.Manifold.localPoint.brief: Usage depends on the manifold type.

box2d.ManifoldPoint.localPoint.brief: Usage depends on the manifold type.

box2d.ManifoldPoint.id.brief: Identifies the contact point between the two shapes.

box2d.ContactID.key.brief: Used to compare contact ids quickly.

box2d.ContactFeature.typeA.brief: The feature type on shape A: 0 for a vertex, 1 for a face.

box2d.ContactFeature.typeB.brief: The feature type on shape B: 0 for a vertex, 1 for a face.

box2d.WorldManifold.normal.brief: World vector pointing from A to B.

box2d.WorldManifold.separations.brief: A negative value indicates overlap, in meters.

box2d.Joint.GetAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor on bodyA in world coordinates.

box2d.Joint.GetAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor on bodyB in world coordinates.

box2d.Joint.GetReactionForce.brief: Gets the reaction force on bodyB at the joint anchor.

box2d.Joint.GetReactionTorque.brief: Gets the reaction torque on bodyB.

box2d.Joint.GetNext.brief: Gets the next joint in the world's joint list.

box2d.Joint.SetUserData.brief:
Sets the application data. This is the only way to attach it to a
joint, since a joint definition carries none.

box2d.Joint.IsEnabled.brief: Whether either attached body is enabled.

box2d.Joint.GetCollideConnected.brief:
Whether the attached bodies collide. Changing it has no effect on
fixtures that already overlap.

box2d.Joint.Dump.brief: Dumps this joint to the log.

box2d.Joint.ShiftOrigin.brief: Shifts the origin of any points stored in world coordinates.

box2d.ContactListener.BeginContact.brief: Called when two fixtures begin to touch.

box2d.ContactListener.EndContact.brief: Called when two fixtures stop touching.

box2d.ContactListener.PreSolve.brief: Called after a contact is updated and before it goes to the solver.

box2d.ContactListener.PostSolve.brief: Called after the solver, with the impulses it applied.

box2d.DebugDraw.ClearFlags.brief: Clears flags from the current flags.

box2d.BodyDef.type.brief: The body type. Default is `b2_staticBody`. A dynamic body with zero mass gets a mass of one.

box2d.BodyDef.position.brief: The world position. Avoid creating bodies at the origin, where shapes overlap.

box2d.BodyDef.linearVelocity.brief: The linear velocity of the body's origin in world coordinates.

box2d.BodyDef.linearDamping.brief: Reduces the linear velocity. Units are 1/time.

box2d.BodyDef.angularDamping.brief: Reduces the angular velocity. Units are 1/time.

box2d.BodyDef.allowSleep.brief: `false` keeps the body from sleeping, at a CPU cost. Default is `true`.

box2d.BodyDef.awake.brief: Whether the body starts awake. Default is `true`.

box2d.BodyDef.bullet.brief:
Prevents a fast dynamic body from tunneling through other moving
bodies. Use it sparingly; it costs processing time.

box2d.BodyDef.enabled.brief: Whether the body starts enabled. Default is `true`.

box2d.BodyDef.userData.brief: Application data. Must be a table.

box2d.BodyDef.gravityScale.brief: Scales the gravity applied to this body. Default is 1.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.referenceAngle.brief: bodyB's angle minus bodyA's angle in the reference state, in radians.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.lowerAngle.brief: The lower angle limit in radians.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.upperAngle.brief: The upper angle limit in radians.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.motorSpeed.brief: The desired motor speed, usually in radians per second.

box2d.RevoluteJointDef.maxMotorTorque.brief: The maximum motor torque, usually in N-m.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.GetJointSpeed.brief: Gets the current joint angular speed.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.IsLimitEnabled.brief: Whether the joint limit is enabled.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.EnableLimit.brief: Enables or disables the joint limit.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.IsMotorEnabled.brief: Whether the joint motor is enabled.

box2d.RevoluteJoint.EnableMotor.brief: Enables or disables the joint motor.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.localAxisA.brief: The translation unit axis in bodyA.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.referenceAngle.brief: bodyB's angle minus bodyA's angle, in radians.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.lowerTranslation.brief: The lower translation limit, usually in meters.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.upperTranslation.brief: The upper translation limit, usually in meters.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.maxMotorForce.brief: The maximum motor force, usually in N.

box2d.PrismaticJointDef.motorSpeed.brief: The desired motor speed, usually in meters per second.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.GetLocalAxisA.brief: Gets the joint axis relative to bodyA.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.GetJointSpeed.brief: Gets the current joint translation speed.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.IsLimitEnabled.brief: Whether the joint limit is enabled.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.EnableLimit.brief: Enables or disables the joint limit.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.IsMotorEnabled.brief: Whether the joint motor is enabled.

box2d.PrismaticJoint.EnableMotor.brief: Enables or disables the joint motor.

box2d.DistanceJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.DistanceJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.DistanceJointDef.maxLength.brief: The maximum length. Must be at least the minimum length.

box2d.DistanceJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.DistanceJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.DistanceJoint.SetLength.brief: Sets the rest length, which Box2D clamps to a stable minimum.

box2d.DistanceJoint.SetMinLength.brief: Sets the minimum length, which Box2D clamps to a stable minimum.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.groundAnchorA.brief: The first ground anchor in world coordinates. It never moves.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.groundAnchorB.brief: The second ground anchor in world coordinates. It never moves.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.lengthA.brief: The reference length of the segment attached to bodyA.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.lengthB.brief: The reference length of the segment attached to bodyB.

box2d.PulleyJointDef.ratio.brief: The pulley ratio, used to simulate a block-and-tackle.

box2d.PulleyJoint.GetLengthA.brief: Gets the reference length of the segment attached to bodyA.

box2d.PulleyJoint.GetLengthB.brief: Gets the reference length of the segment attached to bodyB.

box2d.PulleyJoint.GetCurrentLengthA.brief: Gets the current length of the segment attached to bodyA.

box2d.PulleyJoint.GetCurrentLengthB.brief: Gets the current length of the segment attached to bodyB.

box2d.MouseJointDef.target.brief: The initial world target point, assumed to coincide with the body anchor.

box2d.MouseJointDef.maxForce.brief: The maximum force used to move the body, usually a multiple of its weight.

box2d.GearJointDef.joint1.brief: The first revolute or prismatic joint.

box2d.GearJointDef.joint2.brief: The second revolute or prismatic joint.

box2d.WheelJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.WheelJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.WheelJointDef.lowerTranslation.brief: The lower translation limit, usually in meters.

box2d.WheelJointDef.upperTranslation.brief: The upper translation limit, usually in meters.

box2d.WheelJointDef.maxMotorTorque.brief: The maximum motor torque, usually in N-m.

box2d.WheelJointDef.motorSpeed.brief: The desired motor speed in radians per second.

box2d.WheelJointDef.stiffness.brief: The suspension stiffness, typically in N/m.

box2d.WheelJointDef.damping.brief: The suspension damping, typically in N*s/m.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetLocalAxisA.brief: Gets the joint axis relative to bodyA.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetJointLinearSpeed.brief: Gets the current joint linear speed.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetJointAngularSpeed.brief: Gets the current joint angular speed.

box2d.WheelJoint.IsLimitEnabled.brief: Whether the joint limit is enabled.

box2d.WheelJoint.EnableLimit.brief: Enables or disables the joint translation limit.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetLowerLimit.brief: Gets the lower joint translation limit.

box2d.WheelJoint.GetUpperLimit.brief: Gets the upper joint translation limit.

box2d.WheelJoint.IsMotorEnabled.brief: Whether the joint motor is enabled.

box2d.WheelJoint.EnableMotor.brief: Enables or disables the joint motor.

box2d.WeldJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.WeldJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.WeldJointDef.referenceAngle.brief: bodyB's angle minus bodyA's angle in the reference state, in radians.

box2d.WeldJointDef.stiffness.brief: The rotational stiffness in N*m. 0 disables softness.

box2d.WeldJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.WeldJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.FrictionJointDef.localAnchorA.brief: The anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.FrictionJointDef.localAnchorB.brief: The anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.FrictionJointDef.maxForce.brief: The maximum friction force in N.

box2d.FrictionJointDef.maxTorque.brief: The maximum friction torque in N-m.

box2d.FrictionJoint.GetLocalAnchorA.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyA's origin.

box2d.FrictionJoint.GetLocalAnchorB.brief: Gets the anchor relative to bodyB's origin.

box2d.MotorJointDef.linearOffset.brief: bodyB's position minus bodyA's position, in bodyA's frame, in meters.

box2d.MotorJointDef.angularOffset.brief: bodyB's angle minus bodyA's angle, in radians.

box2d.MotorJointDef.maxForce.brief: The maximum motor force in N.

box2d.MotorJointDef.maxTorque.brief: The maximum motor torque in N-m.

box2d.MotorJointDef.correctionFactor.brief: The position correction factor, from 0 to 1.

box2d.MotorJoint.SetLinearOffset.brief: Sets the target linear offset, in bodyA's frame.

box2d.MotorJoint.GetLinearOffset.brief: Gets the target linear offset, in bodyA's frame.

box2d.DebugDrawCallbacks.flags.brief: What to draw: a sum of {@link b2Draw} bits.

box2d.DebugDrawCallbacks.DrawSolidCircle.brief: Draws a filled circle, with `axis` marking its rotation.

box2d.DebugDrawCallbacks.DrawPoint.brief: Accepted, but never called: the extension's `Draw::DrawPoint` has an empty body.

box2d.PolygonShape.Set.brief:
Creates a convex hull from local points. The points may be reordered,
and collinear points are kept, which can lead to poor stacking.

box2d.PolygonShape.Validate.brief: Validates convexity. This is a very time consuming operation.

box2d.CircleShape.SetPosition.brief: Sets the center relative to the body origin.

box2d.CircleShape.GetPosition.brief: Gets the center relative to the body origin.

box2d.ChainShape.RayCast.brief: Casts a ray against one segment of the chain.

box2d.ChainShape.ComputeAABB.brief: Computes the axis-aligned bounding box of one segment of the chain.

box2d.ChainShape.CreateLoop.brief: Creates a loop, connecting the last vertex to the first.

box2d.ChainShape.CreateChain.brief: Creates a chain with ghost vertices that connect it to other chains.

box2d.ChainShape.GetChildEdge.brief: Gets one segment of the chain as an edge.

box2d.ChainShape.GetNextVertex.brief: Gets the ghost vertex after the end.

box2d.ChainShape.GetPrevVertex.brief: Gets the ghost vertex before the start.

box2d.EdgeShape.SetOneSided.brief:
Makes the edge part of a sequence. `v0` precedes the edge and `v3`
follows it; they smooth movement across junctions. The collision becomes
one-sided, with the normal pointing right when looking from `v1` to `v2`.

box2d.EdgeShape.SetTwoSided.brief: Makes the edge isolated. The collision is two-sided.

box2d.EdgeShape.GetVertex0.brief: Gets the vertex before the edge.

box2d.EdgeShape.GetVertex3.brief: Gets the vertex after the edge.

box2d.EdgeShape.IsOneSided.brief: Whether the edge collides on one side only.

daabbcc3d.brief: Dynamic AABB trees in 3D for overlap queries and ray casts without a physics engine.

daabbcc3d.new_group.brief: New empty group for AABBs. Every group is a separate dynamic tree.

daabbcc3d.remove_group.brief: Removes the group and all associated AABBs and game objects.

daabbcc3d.insert_aabb.brief: Insert an AABB into the group.

daabbcc3d.insert_gameobject.brief:
Insert a game object and its associated AABB into a group. Most suitable
for constantly moving game objects; use `insert_aabb` for static ones.

daabbcc3d.update_aabb.brief:
Updates the AABB position and size. Does not affect game objects, whose
AABB positions are overwritten by the internal update.

daabbcc3d.update_gameobject_size.brief: Updates the size of a game object's AABB.

daabbcc3d.remove.brief: Removes the AABB and its game object from the group.

daabbcc3d.query_aabb.brief: Query possible overlaps using a raw AABB.

daabbcc3d.query_id.brief: Query possible overlaps using an AABB ID.

daabbcc3d.query_aabb_sort.brief: Query possible overlaps using a raw AABB, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc3d.query_id_sort.brief: Query possible overlaps using an AABB ID, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc3d.raycast.brief: Perform a ray cast against the group.

daabbcc3d.raycast_sort.brief: Perform a ray cast against the group, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc3d.run.brief:
Pause or resume the internal game object position update. Enabled by
default; it does not iterate when no game objects are registered.

daabbcc3d.update_frequency.brief:
Set an independent frequency for the game object position update. The
default is the project's `display.frequency`.

daabbcc3d.rebuild.brief: Partially or fully rebuild a group.

daabbcc3d.rebuild_all.brief:
Partially or fully rebuild all groups.

The runtime reads the flag from the second argument, so pass `undefined`
first.

daabbcc3d.reset.brief:
Removes all AABBs, groups and game objects, resetting to the initial state.
Recommended when you are done with it, such as when a level ends.

daabbcc3d.UPDATE_PARTIALREBUILD.brief: Partial rebuild. Recommended for lots of moving AABBs.

daabbcc3d.BitsHit.category_bits.brief: The category bits the AABB was inserted with.

daabbcc3d.SortedHit.distance.brief: Distance from the query or ray origin.

imp.brief: Image processing on Defold buffers: 3x3 convolution kernels for blur, sharpen and edge detection.

imp.convolution.brief:
Applies a row-major 3x3 convolution kernel to `src` and writes the result
into `dst`. Both buffers must carry a uint8 `rgb` stream of three or four
components per pixel and hold at least `width * height` elements. The
call checks that each stream is uint8 and that the two streams' component
counts match, but not either buffer's element count, so an undersized
buffer is read or written past its end.

taptic_engine.brief: Haptic feedback through the iOS Taptic Engine: impact, notification and selection events.

taptic_engine.isSupported.brief: Reports whether the device supports the Taptic Engine.

def_windward_jps.brief: Find paths on 2D grids with Jump Point Search.

def_windward_jps.create_grid.brief: Creates a grid to find paths on.

def_windward_jps.Grid.find_path.brief:
Finds a path between two cells. A start or goal that is outside the
grid or blocked, or a goal that cannot be reached, fails with an error
message instead of a path, so check `path` before reading it.

def_windward_jps.Grid.is_walkable.brief:
Whether a cell is inside the grid and not blocked. Use it to check a
cell before searching from or to it.

gyro.brief: Gyroscope rotation for Defold on iOS and Android, delivered as a quaternion every frame.

gyro.start.brief:
Starts the gyroscope. While started, the listener is invoked every frame
with the device rotation as a quaternion.

uptime.brief: Time elapsed since the device booted, in seconds.

uptime.get.brief: Returns the time since the device booted, in seconds.

share.brief: Defold native extension to share data from a Defold application using native dialogs

share.text.brief: Share text using a native sharing dialog.

share.image.brief:
Share an image, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. On
Android the image must be decodable by `BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray()`,
on iOS and macOS by `UIImage.initWithData`, and on HTML5 it may be a data
URI or any format the browser supports.

share.file.brief:
Share a file, with optional text, using a native sharing dialog. The file
keeps its original name and extension.

share.FileOptions.title.brief: Title to be shared. May be ignored by the target.

daabbcc.brief: Dynamic Tree (aka AABB Tree) native extension for Defold Engine

daabbcc.new_group.brief: New empty group for AABBs. Every group is a separate dynamic tree.

daabbcc.remove_group.brief: Removes the group and all associated AABBs and game objects.

daabbcc.insert_aabb.brief: Insert an AABB into the group.

daabbcc.insert_gameobject.brief:

daabbcc.update_aabb.brief:

daabbcc.update_gameobject_size.brief: Updates the size of a game object's AABB.

daabbcc.remove.brief: Removes the AABB and its game object from the group.

daabbcc.query_aabb.brief: Query possible overlaps using a raw AABB.

daabbcc.query_id.brief: Query possible overlaps using an AABB ID.

daabbcc.query_aabb_sort.brief: Query possible overlaps using a raw AABB, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc.query_id_sort.brief: Query possible overlaps using an AABB ID, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc.raycast.brief: Perform a ray cast against the group.

daabbcc.raycast_sort.brief: Perform a ray cast against the group, ordered from closest to farthest.

daabbcc.run.brief:
Pause or resume the internal game object position update. Enabled by
default; it does not iterate when no game objects are registered.

daabbcc.update_frequency.brief:
Set an independent frequency for the game object position update. The

daabbcc.rebuild.brief: Partially or fully rebuild a group.

daabbcc.rebuild_all.brief:
Partially or fully rebuild all groups.

daabbcc.reset.brief:
